New since the last What to Test notes:

LOOK AND FEEL
- New matte Face 1 faceplates on all four faces (Modern, Platinum, Vintage, Texture). The screen stays black when nothing plays; power button and slider are the plate's own.
- Knobs show a lit value readout while you turn them, FX knobs glide smoothly (0-100%), and knobs and buttons are easier to grab.
- New app icon. MENU and SAMPLER popups share one hardware look. Hold MODERN to pick Default or Platinum.
- KITS and PATTERNS menus open in folders per genre with counts; the loaded item's folder opens itself.

PADS AND SEQUENCER
- Pads fire the moment a finger lands; every finger is its own hit.
- Pads dent where your finger lands, deeper on harder hits.
- Lighter touch path: a pad hit redraws only the screen, pad flashes start on the finger and fade at 60 fps, idle pads use no CPU.
- Mouse / trackpad: scroll over any knob to turn it.
- Hold a pad for its SOUND / SAMPLES / PAD window, with per-pad NOTE REPEAT.
- Every sound plays as a full one-shot; note length no longer cuts it.
- EMPTY pads are fully silent everywhere.
- Step rows: swipe to fill, swipe from a lit step to clear, hover lift with a mouse. Piano roll plays the note you place or move. STEPS fills moved to the note right-click menu.
- Loop mode: holding a pad opens the Drum Sequencer on that pad's track.

SOUNDS AND KITS
- Every stock sound has a Break King name (BK NO n KIND); your own sounds show as BK MY n KIND.
- Every 808 is tuned to C.
- Channel rack loads in this order: 808, kick, clap, snare, hi hats, open hat, rim, low tom, high tom, perc 1, perc 2, crash.
- Vintage plays live-drummer styles only: acoustic kits and 13 live styles. Drum machine era kits have their own DRUM MACHINE ERA folder in the other modes.
- Rock and Live Soul kits use only acoustic drums.
- Import takes every audio file type (WAV, AIFF, MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG and more) and works from iCloud and the Samples folder.

PATTERNS
- Every PATTERNS genre has 50 presets. New genre groups added; Bay Area has 50 presets and 50 matching kits.
- HUMANIZE plays each genre's own drummer feel.

FX
- Every FX knob and CLIP DRIVE loads at 0%; every mode is dry at 0%.
- Vintage: DRIVE leads the FX row and its tape rides on DRIVE.
- Texture: effects come only from its knobs; REVERB is a bright drum plate.

MIDI AND PLUG-IN
- Plug-in defaults to MIDI OUT ONE TRACK (whole kit on channel 1, notes 36-47).
- Akai MPK Mini is named on the default pad map (pads 1-12 = notes 36-47).
- Fixed a crash when Logic Pro reopens a song with BreaKing in it.

Please try:
- Finger drum fast rolls and several fingers at once; listen for missed or doubled hits, and watch the pad flashes keep up.
- With a mouse or trackpad: scroll over Face 1 and Face 2 knobs, click pads, right-click a track name.
- Turn each FX knob on every face, from 0% up, and check the readout matches the sound.
- Load kits and presets fast from the folder menus in every mode, including Vintage.
- Import a FLAC or MP3 from iCloud onto a pad.
- In Logic, reopen a saved song with BreaKing and record its MIDI out.
